description: Move an action along by naming the target `state`: "in_progress" means you have started, which is yours to say as the assignee; "pending" means not now, or REOPENS a resolved action - either party may reopen, because disagreeing with "done" is the whole reason resolved exists; "resolved" means you think it is finished, and is reversible on purpose; "closed" is terminal and needs a `resolution` of "done", "wont_do" or "cancelled". Nothing comes back out of closed: to continue, raise_action with this one as its `parent_action`.

resolution.description:
resolution is REQUIRED when closing: done | wont_do | cancelled. It is
 stored rather than guessed from who closed it.

space.description: space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in.

state.description:
state is the target:
   "in_progress" - you have started. Yours to say, as the assignee.
   "pending"     - not now (from in_progress), or REOPEN a resolved action.
                   Either party may reopen: disagreeing with "done" is the
                   whole reason resolved exists.
   "resolved"    - you think it is finished. Reversible on purpose.
   "closed"      - finished, do not touch it. Terminal, and it needs a
                   `resolution`. To carry on afterwards, raise a new action
                   with this one as its parent_action.

name: set_action_state
title: Set action state
